title: Split BaseDynamics superclass from Dynamics, which does too much
body:
To help with the ase3/4 work, we need to change atoms/calculator handling on dynamics and optimizers.

For this reason we split off a smaller superclass, BaseDynamics, from the current one.  This is not totally done yet
since we would also like to get rid of Atoms from the superclass, so it only handles logging, trajectory etc., but it's on the way.
